description: The bar chart illustrates the “% point difference” values for two multilingual models (mBERT and XLM-R) across four probing configurations labeled by hidden-layer settings and activation type. The horizontal axis contains the categorical configurations in left-to-right order: “hidden:[50], linear,” “hidden:[], linear,” “hidden:[100], ReLU,” and “hidden:[50, 50], ReLU.” The vertical axis is the value axis labeled “% point difference,” shown on a linear scale with labeled ticks at approximately −0.2, −0.1, 0.0, and 0.2 (with intermediate gridlines suggesting 0.1 spacing), spanning roughly from −0.2 to just above 0.2. Each category has two side-by-side bars: a light blue bar for mBERT and a darker blue bar for XLM-R (as indicated by the legend in the upper right). For “hidden:[50], linear,” mBERT is about −0.20 and XLM-R about −0.06; for “hidden:[], linear,” mBERT is about +0.09 and XLM-R about +0.21; for “hidden:[100], ReLU,” mBERT is about −0.11 and XLM-R about +0.02; and for “hidden:[50, 50], ReLU,” mBERT is about −0.17 and XLM-R about −0.13. The bars are grouped by configuration (not stacked), appear in the fixed order shown on the x-axis rather than being sorted by value, and there are no additional visual emphases such as annotations or outlines beyond the color coding and gridlines.
